video.EncodeAccelVP9*: Set VP9 in the output IVF path This commit slightly tweaks the output path for VP9 tests. Previously --test_stream_data included a path with VP8 in the name. As an example, when running video.EncodeAccelVP9I420 the following path was generated: /tmp/tast_out.537191078/video.EncodeAccelVP9I420/bear-320x192.vp8.ivf With this change: /tmp/tast_out.041377173/video.EncodeAccelVP9I420/bear-320x192.vp9.ivf BUG=None TEST=`tast run ${DUT_IP} video.EncodeAccelVP9*` - Check that video_encode_accelerator_unittest --test_stream_data uses an output path including VP9. TEST=`tast run ${DUT_IP} video.EncodeAccel*` - Verify all tests pass. Change-Id: I60ffaa3fccb693844c9c468301d78d97d80f22b9 Signed-off-by: Edward Baker <edward.baker@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1715747 Tested-by: Kevin L Derossett <kevin.l.derossett@intel.com> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Keiichi Watanabe <keiichiw@chromium.org>
